_note: Limited-use features from the authored content layer: the subclasses in src/lib/srd/subclasses.json and the lineages added to src/lib/srd/races.json, as spendable counters. Same row shape as src/lib/classes/resources.json plus `proficiency` (uses = that multiple of the proficiency bonus), `scale` (a descending [level, uses] table) and `byLevel` (a pool sized by character level). Original wording, like the tables themselves. A feature listed here is enforced: use_resource spends it and rests refill it.

resources.guidance: A maneuver that rides a weapon attack (Trip, Disarming, Precision, Menacing, Feinting, Quick Toss, Grappling Strike, Maneuvering and the rest) is named in pc_attack's maneuver: the die goes to the damage or the roll it names, its save DC is 8 + proficiency + Strength or Dexterity, and Feinting Attack and Quick Toss take the bonus action. Parry, Riposte and Brace are reactions: use_reaction. Rally and Commander's Strike are use_resource with variant 'rally' or 'commander's strike' and the ally's targetCharacterId (each takes the bonus action; Commander's Strike also forgoes one attack). A maneuver that rides a check or a move (Ambush, Bait and Switch, Commanding Presence, Evasive Footwork, Tactical Assessment) is use_resource with that maneuver as the variant. A die is never spent with no maneuver named.

The shared pool behind every psionic feature of this subclass. Name the use in variant: Telekinetic Movement and Psychic Whispers take an action, Psychic Teleportation a bonus action; Psionic Strike and Psi-Bolstered Knack ride a hit or a check already made; Protective Field is a reaction (use_reaction). Every die returns on a long rest; once per short or long rest a bonus action regains one spent die (use_resource 'Psionic Recovery'). The die size grows with level: d6, then d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th and d12 at 17th.
A bonus action that regains one spent Psionic Energy die, once per short or long rest. Spend it with use_resource 'Psionic Recovery'; the server returns the die.
A bonus action granting advantage on weapon attacks this turn plus temporary hit points: 5 at 3rd level, 10 at 10th, 15 at 15th.
A bonus action for 1 minute: become Large, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and one extra damage die per turn.
Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Runic Shield' when an attack hits an ally within 60 feet. The attacker rolls the d20 again and must use the new roll.
One extra melee attack made from the echo's space when taking the Attack action. Resolve it with pc_attack like any other.
When the echo is destroyed by damage, gain 2d6 + Constitution modifier temporary hit points.

Use use_reaction 'Shadow Martyr' when an attack hits another creature, with that creature's targetCharacterId. The echo takes the attack and the hit becomes a miss. The server does not track the echo: refuse it when none is out, and remove the echo when the reply says so.

A reaction when the fighter or a creature they can see within 5 feet is hit, while wielding a melee weapon or a shield: 1d8 on the target's AC against that attack, and resistance to its damage if it still hits. Pass targetCharacterId for another creature; the server re-resolves the hit.

A reaction as damage reduces the samurai to 0 hit points without killing them: they put off falling unconscious and take an extra turn at once. Damage at 0 during it still causes death save failures; when it ends they fall unconscious if still at 0. The server gives the turn.

An arrow's magical rider, chosen from the options known and applied on a hit: Banishing, Beguiling, Bursting, Enfeebling, Grasping, Piercing, Seeking or Shadow. Its save DC is 8 + proficiency + Intelligence.
Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Warding Flare' when an attack hits the cleric or, with Improved Flare, a creature within 30 feet. The attack is rolled again at disadvantage.

Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Wrath of the Storm' when a creature hits the cleric in melee. It takes 2d8 lightning or thunder (variant names one; else whichever hurts it more), halved on a Dexterity save.
A bonus-action weapon attack after taking the Attack action, made with pc_attack (feature "War Priest"); the attack spends the use.
An action sensing undead within 60 feet that aren't behind total cover, and where they are.
Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Sentinel at Death's Door' when a critical hit lands on the cleric or, with targetCharacterId, a creature within 30 feet. It becomes a normal hit.

Spent through use_resource 'Blessing of the Forge' with variant 'armor' or 'weapon' (targetCharacterId the creature it goes to), out of a fight, after a long rest: bless a suit of armor (+1 AC) or a weapon (+1 to attack and damage rolls) the cleric touches, until they use the feature again. Once a long rest. The server lays the blessing and takes the earlier one off.

Share the cleric's 300-foot darkvision for an hour with willing creatures within 10 feet, as many as their Wisdom modifier (minimum one). Once per long rest, or again by expending a spell slot of any level.
At least a minute of meditation (concentration, up to the cleric's Wisdom score in minutes) reading an object's owners or a place's past events, as far back as the Wisdom score in days.

An action bonding up to the cleric's proficiency bonus of willing creatures within 30 feet for 10 minutes: once a turn each can add a d4 to an attack, check or save while within 30 feet of another bonded creature (60 feet from 17th level).
A bonus action in dim light or darkness granting a flying speed equal to the walking speed for 1 minute.
A pool of d6s equal to the druid's level. As a bonus action spend up to half the druid's level of them on one creature within 120 feet: it regains the total rolled and 1 temporary hit point per die.
A bonus action teleporting the druid 60 feet (variant 'self'), or an action teleporting a willing creature they touch 30 feet (variant 'touch').

An action creates the cannon for an hour (once a long rest; a spell slot buys another). A bonus action activates it: 'Activate Cannon' with variant flamethrower or protector, or the Force Ballista through pc_attack.
A bonus action raising a 30-foot Bear, Hawk or Unicorn spirit aura for 1 minute.

This is not spent by choice: the next time the druid drops to 0 hit points or is incapacitated by something other than their own doing, the server spends it and four wolves appear beside them as allies, guarding them and attacking their foes for an hour without concentration.
A reaction reanimating a beast or humanoid that just died within 10 feet as a zombie under the druid's command for an hour.
Free castings of guiding bolt from the map, without a spell slot: pc_attack with spell 'Guiding Bolt', and the cast spends a use (no use_resource call).

A reaction used when a creature the druid can see within 30 feet is about to make an attack roll, a check or a save: a d6 added to that roll (Weal) or taken off it (Woe). The omen is read from a die rolled at each long rest (even Weal, odd Woe) and holds until the next one. The druid's player chooses it before the roll, at the hold before their own check or save or at the watch stop before another's (in a fight the stop comes for it; out of one, with the Watch toggle on). Never spend it with use_resource: a roll already made gets none, and the spend is refused.

This is not spent by choice: the next time damage would drop the druid to 0 hit points without killing them outright while the wildfire spirit is out, the server lets the spirit fall in their place, brings the druid back at half their hit point maximum, and burns the use.

After a short rest: dream (the druid as messenger), scrying or teleportation circle without a slot or material components. Cast the spell with its own tool and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).
After a minute of performance, up to the bard's Charisma modifier (minimum one) of humanoids within 60 feet who watched it all are charmed for an hour on a failed Wisdom save.

A bonus action for a minute of majesty (concentration): each turn the bard may cast command as a bonus action with no slot (the cast tools charge it that way while the mantle holds), and a creature charmed by the bard automatically fails its save against that command.
A bonus action for 1 minute: an attacker must pass a Charisma save or lose the attack and be unable to target the bard that turn.
A minute of private conversation frightens a humanoid for an hour on a failed Wisdom save.
A reaction capturing the shadow of a humanoid that died within 30 feet, wearable as their identity for an hour.
A whispered secret charms a creature within 30 feet for 8 hours on a failed Wisdom save, and it obeys reasonable requests.
A reaction copying a successful Bardic Inspiration die onto another creature within 60 feet, without spending an inspiration use.
An action: up to the bard's Charisma modifier (minimum one) of creatures within 60 feet understand the bard for an hour. A spell slot buys another use.
An action creating a nonmagical item worth up to 20 times the bard's level. A spell slot buys extra uses.

An action animating a Large or smaller nonmagical item within 30 feet as a Dancing Item for an hour: AC 16, 10 + five times the bard level hit points, a Force-Empowered Slam of 1d10 + proficiency force with the bard's spell attack. Once per long rest; a spell slot of 3rd level or higher buys another use.

An hour-long ritual during a rest with up to the bard's proficiency bonus in willing creatures: the bard learns one divination or necromancy spell from any list, of a level they can cast and no higher than the number of participants, until they start a long rest.
A bonus action granting up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until the barbarian's next turn.
A free casting of augury or clairvoyance using Wisdom, with no slot or components: cast the spell with its own tool and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).
An action sensing spells and magic items within 60 feet that aren't behind total cover, and the school of each spell.

Touch a creature: for 10 minutes it adds a d3 to attack rolls and ability checks, or it rolls a d3 and regains one expended spell slot of that level or lower (each creature takes the slot only once per long rest).
A natural-weapon hit forces a Wisdom save: the target either attacks a creature of the barbarian's choice or takes 2d12 psychic damage.

Part of entering a rage, with no action of its own: up to the barbarian's Constitution modifier (minimum one) of willing creatures within 30 feet each add a d6 to the damage of one hit on each of their turns until the rage ends, and the barbarian gains 5 temporary hit points per creature that accepts.

A bonus action cursing a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute (use_resource with targetEnemyId): the warlock adds their proficiency bonus to damage against it and scores a critical hit against it on a 19 or 20, and regains warlock level + Charisma modifier hit points when it dies. The server applies the damage, the critical range and the healing.
An action charming or frightening every creature in a 10-foot cube that fails a Wisdom save, until the end of the warlock's next turn.
A reaction on taking damage that turns the warlock invisible and teleports them 60 feet.

An action: a creature within 60 feet is charmed or frightened (the warlock's choice) for a minute on a failed Wisdom save, lost in an illusory misty realm; it ends if the warlock's concentration breaks or the creature takes damage.

Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Entropic Ward' when an attack hits the warlock. The attack is rolled again at disadvantage; if it then misses, the warlock's next attack roll against that creature before the end of their next turn has advantage.
A pool of d6s equal to 1 + the warlock's level. Spend up to their Charisma modifier of them as a bonus action to heal a creature within 60 feet.

This is not spent by choice: the next time the warlock would make a death save, the server has them rise at half their hit points instead, on their feet, burning (2d8 + Charisma radiant) and blinding every enemy within 30 feet until the end of their turn, and in a fight the turn is theirs to take.
A humanoid the warlock kills rises as an obedient specter with extra temporary hit points until the next long rest.

A bonus action summoning a 10-foot spectral tentacle for 1 minute: a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of it for 1d8 cold damage (2d8 from 10th level), and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until the start of the warlock's next turn.

Evard's black tentacles once without a spell slot; casting it gives temporary hit points equal to the warlock level and damage can't break the concentration on it. Cast it with its own tool and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).
Teleport the warlock and up to five willing creatures within 30 feet to a body of water within a mile: in a fight they leave the board, and a fight with no hero left ends.
A bonus action for 1 minute: 1d10 + warlock level temporary hit points, immunity to being frightened, and one creature hit each turn is frightened on a failed Wisdom save.

A reaction as damage reduces the warlock to 0 hit points: they drop to 1 hit point instead, each enemy within 30 feet takes 2d10 + the warlock level in necrotic damage, and they gain a level of exhaustion. It returns after 1d4 long rests. The server applies all of it.

An action projecting the warlock's spirit for up to an hour (concentration): resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, a flying speed equal to the walking speed, movement through creatures and objects, and in Form of Dread, once a turn, hit points back equal to half the necrotic damage they deal.
Regain 1d8 + Constitution modifier hit points on succeeding at a death save or stabilizing a creature.
A bonus action healing 1d8 + warlock level and reattaching severed body parts.

Bottled Respite: as an action the warlock vanishes into the vessel for up to twice their proficiency bonus in hours, leaving early as a bonus action. From 10th level up to five willing creatures within 30 feet come too; staying 10 minutes gives them a short rest's benefits, and Hit Dice spent inside add the warlock's proficiency bonus.

The effect of one spell of 6th level or lower with a casting time of one action, from any class's list, ignoring requirements and costly components. It returns only after 1d4 long rests; the server keeps the count.
Advantage on one attack, ability check or saving throw. The GM may trigger a Wild Magic Surge afterwards to restore the use.

Add 2d4 to a failed saving throw or a missed attack, possibly turning it into a success. A player's missed attack or failed request_roll save waits on a card that offers this, so do not spend it for them there. Use it here only for a roll that cannot wait (a forced save, an agent's seat), and narrate the result.
A bonus action when the sorcerer has fewer than half of their hit points left, restoring hit points equal to half their maximum. The server heals them.

This is not spent by choice: the next time damage other than radiant or a critical hit would drop the sorcerer to 0 hit points without killing them outright, the server rolls their Charisma save (DC 5 + the damage taken) and, on a success, leaves them at 1 hit point and burns the use.

A reaction used when a creature within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage: the roll is made with one d20. The sorcerer's player chooses it before the roll, at the hold before their own check or save or at the watch stop before another's (in a fight the stop comes for it; out of one, with the Watch toggle on). Never spend it with use_resource: a roll already made gets none, and the spend is refused.
A minute during which attacks against the sorcerer cannot have advantage and any d20 of 9 or lower counts as a 10 on their attacks, checks and saves.
A 30-foot cube healing 100 hit points among creatures in it, ending spells of 6th level or lower and repairing objects.
Teleport 120 feet, pulling creatures toward the vacated space for 3d10 force damage on a failed Strength save.

A bonus action releasing the current phase: Full Moon blinds creatures of the sorcerer's choice within 30 feet on a failed Constitution save and heals one of them 3d8; New Moon deals 3d10 necrotic and speed 0 on a failed Dexterity save and turns the sorcerer invisible; Crescent Moon teleports them and one willing creature 60 feet with resistance to all damage until their next turn. Again for 5 sorcery points.

The current phase's 1st-level spell (shield at the full moon, ray of sickness at the new, color spray at the crescent), cast once without a spell slot until the next long rest: cast it with its own tool and the cast spends the use.

Metamagic on a spell of the current phase's schools costs 1 sorcery point less (minimum 0), and the server does it: pay the Metamagic option with Sorcery Points, then cast the spell with its own tool; a spell of the phase's schools gives 1 point back and spends a boon.
One 1st-level spell of each phase (shield, ray of sickness, color spray) cast once without a spell slot: cast it with its own tool and the cast spends a use.

The server rolls these after each long rest and keeps the numbers. On the wizard's own ability check or saving throw from request_roll it offers them before the roll and waits, so do not spend one for them. In a fight their player can watch for it: the server then stops before an attack, a check or one creature's save and puts the number on the d20 itself, and the result says so. Never name or invent a number.
Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Illusory Self' when an attack hits the wizard. An illusory duplicate takes it, and the attack misses.
Teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing creature within 30 feet (name it in targetCharacterId). Also recharges whenever the wizard casts a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.
A free self-polymorph into a beast of challenge rating 1 or lower, without a spell slot: cast polymorph on themselves and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).
An action granting one until the wizard is incapacitated or rests: darkvision 60 feet, ethereal sight 60 feet, reading any language, or seeing invisible creatures and objects within 10 feet.

Once per turn when a wizard spell damages a creature or object: extra force damage equal to half the wizard level. The wizard starts each day with one surge, gains one by ending a spell with dispel magic or counterspell, and one after a short rest with none; they hold up to their Intelligence modifier.

A bonus action for 1 minute: add the Intelligence modifier to AC, 10 feet of speed, advantage on Acrobatics, and the Intelligence modifier (at least +1) on Constitution saves to keep concentration. It ends if the wizard wears medium or heavy armor or a shield, or is incapacitated.

A reaction forcing a creature within 30 feet to reroll an attack, check or save after the wizard sees whether it succeeded; the second roll stands. Against a hit on the wizard or an ally by an attacker within 30 feet, use_reaction 'Chronal Shift' (targetCharacterId for the creature hit): the server rolls the attack again and settles the hit. The wizard's own failed roll, and a player ally's failed check, save or attack, offer it on the after-the-roll card (the wizard's player answers an ally's on their own screen). In a fight the wizard's player can watch for it: a creature's save against a spell or an area, an ally's save against a hazard, and a companion's attack stop first, and the server rolls it again if it goes the way the wizard said. Never use_resource it for any of these; only for a roll the engine never threw.
A Large or smaller creature within 60 feet is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of the wizard's next turn, or until it takes damage, on a failed Constitution save.

The wizard casts a spell with a slot of 4th level or lower into a bead: use_spell_slot with the spell, its level and storeIn 'Arcane Abeyance' (storeInCharacterId for whoever is handed the bead). The slot and the action are paid, the spell has no effect now, and this use is spent with it. Whoever holds the bead breaks it with use_item and resolves the spell with its own tool, at the wizard's save DC and attack bonus; the bead fades after an hour.

A reaction adding 1d10 to a weapon attack's damage by a creature within 60 feet, or 2d10 to a creature's falling damage. A player's weapon hit waits on a card that offers the 1d10, so do not spend it for them there. Use it here only for a hit that cannot wait (an enemy's, an agent's seat) or for falling damage, and narrate the result.

A minute (concentration) of crushing gravity in 30 feet: a hostile creature starting its turn there takes 2d10 force and has speed 0 on a failed Strength save, half damage and costly movement on a success. A spell slot of 3rd level or higher buys extra uses.

After each short or long rest, one skill or tool proficiency the Phantom chooses (variant: the skill or the tool), kept until the next choice replaces it. A skill check and a tool check read it as the sheet's own.

variants: whispers of the dead (playing card set)
whispers of the dead (three-dragon ante set)

resources.guidance: A bonus action manifesting the spellbook's mind within 60 feet (it ends beyond 300 feet), so the wizard can cast from its space. Free once per long rest; a spell slot of any level buys another manifestation.

A wizard spell cast from the manifested mind's space: a proficiency-bonus number a day. The server spends one itself when a wizard spell that does not reach from the wizard reaches from the mind's square (its range and a clear path measured from there). Never spend it here: a bare spend is refused.

Once per long rest: the next ritual the wizard casts from their spellbook takes its own casting time, without the 10 extra minutes (in a fight, a ritual cast with an action takes effect at once). Spend it before the ritual; the server skips the minutes. The feature's other half needs no use: a wizard spell cast with a slot may deal a damage type found in another spell of the slot's level in the book, named in cast_at_enemy's damageType or aoe_damage's type.

After a long rest, out of a fight: use_resource 'Master Scrivener' with variant the name of a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the wizard's book that is cast with an action. The server writes the scroll onto their pack; reading it (use_item) casts the spell one level higher, and it vanishes once read or at the next long rest.

A reaction to damage while the Manifest Mind is summoned: all of that damage is prevented and the mind is dismissed; spells totalling 3d6 levels or more vanish from the spellbook until 1d6 long rests pass. The server prevents the damage, rolls the 3d6 and the 1d6, takes the spells out of the book and writes them back when the rests have passed; a book that cannot pay keeps its spells and the wizard drops to 0 hit points. variant may name the spells to lose first, separated by commas.
An action revealing a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, or that it has none.

A reaction forcing a creature that casts a spell within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save against the ranger's spell save DC or lose the spell. Against a spell, spend it BEFORE resolving the creature's spell, as Counterspell is called (targetEnemyId for the caster, variant for the spell it is casting): the server rolls the save and, on a failure, the slot and the action are spent and the cast is refused. Against a teleport, spend it right after the creature teleports (no variant): on a failure the creature is back where it stood. With neither it is refused.
A bonus-action etherealness lasting a single turn.
Sense the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within a mile.
A bonus action granting a 10-foot flying speed for 1 minute, carried by the swarm.
A reaction to damage just taken: resistance to that damage, and the ranger teleports up to 30 feet. The server gives back the resisted half.
A free misty step (a bonus action, no spell slot) that can bring one willing creature within 5 feet along (targetCharacterId).

A free casting of summon fey without a spell slot or material component, once per long rest; it can be cast without concentration, lasting a minute. Cast it with its own tool and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).

Summon the drake with summon_pet, which spends this use (its stat block: 5 + five times the ranger level hit points, a bite for 1d6 + proficiency piercing, immune to its chosen essence; in a fight the ranger's action); with the use spent, summon_pet's level spends a spell slot of 1st level or higher for another.

The ranger or the drake exhales a 30-foot cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison: 8d6 (10d6 from 15th level), halved on a Dexterity save. With the use spent, a spell slot of 3rd level or higher buys another (level).

A reaction when the ranger or their drake takes damage within 30 feet of each other: the one hurt resists that damage. For an attack that hit the ranger, the server gives back the resisted half (use_reaction 'Reflexive Resistance'). For the drake, halve the damage before apply_damage and spend this with use_resource.
After a sneak attack, a second creature within 30 feet takes half the sneak attack dice in necrotic damage.
A bonus action granting 10 minutes of spectral form: a 10-foot fly speed and movement through creatures and objects. A soul trinket buys extra uses.
An hour of invisibility, ending early if the rogue deals damage or forces a saving throw. A Psionic Energy die buys extra uses.

A sneak attack with Psychic Blades stuns a creature for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom save (use_resource 'Rend Mind' with targetEnemyId, after the hit). Three Psionic Energy dice buy extra uses; the server spends them.

A reaction after a spell targets the rogue or catches them: the caster saves with its spellcasting ability against the rogue's spell save DC, and on a failure the spell has no effect on them, and if they can cast its level the rogue knows it for 8 hours and the caster cannot cast it.
An action sensing illusions, shapechangers and other magical deception within 30 feet, without learning what is hidden.

Reroll a missed attack, with advantage. A player's missed attack waits on a card that offers this, so do not spend it for them there. Use it here only for a roll that cannot wait (an agent's seat), and narrate the result.
Spend 5 ki to return a creature dead no more than 24 hours to life with 4d10 + Wisdom hit points, free of every condition it died with.

Replace one Attack-action attack with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line of the monk's chosen damage type: two rolls of the martial arts die (three from 11th level), halved on a Dexterity save. With no use left, 2 ki buys another (the server spends them).
When the monk uses Step of the Wind: a flying speed equal to the walking speed until the end of the turn.

Draconic Presence: a failed Intimidation or Persuasion check is rolled again as a reaction, chosen on the card the roll waits on. The use is spent only when the new roll turns the failure into a success.

A bonus action raising a 10-foot aura for 1 minute: use_resource 'Aspect of the Wyrm' with variant 'frighten' (an enemy starting its turn in it saves on Wisdom or is frightened) or 'ward fire' and the other types (allies in it resist that damage). Three ki buys extra uses; the server spends them.

Not spent with use_resource: use_reaction 'Glorious Defense' when an attack hits the paladin or an ally within 10 feet. It adds their Charisma modifier to that AC, and a resulting miss lets them attack the attacker.
This is not spent by choice: the server drops them to 1 hit point instead of 0 the next time damage would fell them without killing them outright, and burns the use.
A reaction to damage just taken: 1d12 + the goliath's Constitution modifier comes off it. The server rolls it and gives the hit points back.
An action: a touched creature regains hit points equal to a number of d4s equal to the aasimar's proficiency bonus (MotM). Once a long rest.

A bonus action from 3rd level for a minute of transformation: pass variant heavenly wings (a flying speed equal to the walking speed), inner radiance (bright light; each creature within 10 feet takes radiant damage equal to the proficiency bonus at the end of each of the aasimar's turns) or necrotic shroud (creatures within 10 feet make a Charisma save or are frightened until the end of the aasimar's next turn). Once on each turn, one creature the aasimar's attack hits takes extra damage equal to the proficiency bonus: radiant, or necrotic for the shroud. The server lays the form, rolls the shroud's saves, burns with the radiance and adds the damage to the attack.
A bonus action turning the firbolg invisible until the start of their next turn, or until they attack, cast or force a save.
Extra damage equal to the goblin's level on a hit against a creature larger than them: spent after the hit, on the creature hit (targetEnemyId), and the server deals it.

A bonus-action bite, made with pc_attack (weapon "bite", feature "Hungry Jaws"): on a hit the lizardfolk also gains temporary hit points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1). The attack spends the use.

On the tabaxi's own turn, no action: their speed is doubled until the end of that turn. The use comes back at the end of a turn on which they move 0 feet (and on a rest). The server lays the speed and gives the use back.

Adds the artificer's Intelligence modifier to an ability check or saving throw by them or a creature they can see within 30 feet, for the artificer's reaction, before the roll's outcome lands. The server offers it and takes the reaction itself: a player's check or save, a save a creature forces on them included, waits on a card the artificer's player answers, and a roll that cannot wait (a companion's, a creature's spell on a seat an agent plays) stops first for an artificer watching the fight. Never spend it here: a bare spend is refused.

resources.displayName: The Right Tool for the Job
match: the right tool for the job
resources.guidance: With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand and an hour out of a fight, one set of artisan's tools (variant: which) is made and put in the pack; the set the last use made vanishes. The server takes the hour and spends the use itself.

Elixirs brewed on a long rest (one, two from 6th level, three from 15th), each rolled on a d6: healing (2d4 + Intelligence), swiftness (+10 feet of speed for an hour), resilience (+1 AC for 10 minutes), boldness (a d4 on attacks and saves for a minute), flight (a 10-foot flying speed for 10 minutes) or transformation (alter self). A spell slot brews another of a chosen effect. From 9th level a drinker also gains 2d6 + Intelligence temporary hit points.

At the end of a long rest, out of a fight, lay an infusion the artificer knows (variant: which, its choice after a colon: 'Resistant Armor: fire', 'Replicate Magic Item: Bag of Holding') in a nonmagical item they carry (item: which). One infusion an item, each infusion in one item; past the Infused Items limit the oldest ends. The server spends the use itself.

After a long rest, out of a fight, store a 1st or 2nd-level artificer spell of one action (variant: which) in a weapon or focus the artificer carries; the holder casts it with use_item and spell, twice the artificer's Intelligence modifier in times. The server spends the use itself.
Once per turn, a magic-weapon or Steel Defender hit deals an extra 2d6 force damage, or heals a creature within 30 feet of the target 2d6. Rises to 4d6 at 15th level.
Free castings of lesser restoration without a spell slot, with alchemist's supplies as the focus: cast it with its own tool and the cast spends a use (no use_resource call).
A free casting of greater restoration without a spell slot, once a long rest: cast it with its own tool and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).
A free casting of heal without a spell slot, once a long rest: cast it with its own tool and the cast spends the use (no use_resource call).

Casting an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher as a bonus action instead of an action. Spend it with use_resource on their turn; the next such spell they cast this turn then takes the bonus action.

A reaction when a creature dies near the druid or the Wildfire Spirit: the flame heals an ally (variant 'heal', targetCharacterId) or burns an enemy (variant 'burn', targetEnemyId) for 2d10 + WIS. The server rolls and applies it.

The bonus-action melee attack against a marked creature that damaged someone else, on the fighter's next turn: pc_attack feature "Unwavering Mark" at that creature, with advantage and +half the fighter level damage; the attack spends the use. The mark itself the server lays on every melee hit.

An action: move a Large or smaller loose object or a willing creature up to 30 feet with the mind. Free once per short rest; after that each use spends a Psionic Energy die. Spend it with use_resource "Telekinetic Movement": the server takes the free use first, then a die.

A bonus action: the psi warrior and up to INT-modifier allies within 30 feet gain half cover (+2 AC, +2 DEX saves) for a minute. Once per long rest, or by spending a Psionic Energy die. The server applies it.
Telekinesis once without a slot (cast it with its own tool; the cast spends the use); while concentrating on it, a weapon attack as a bonus action (pc_attack feature 'Telekinetic Master').
An action: for a minute, 10 hit points at the start of each turn and enemies within 10 feet save at disadvantage against the paladin's spells. The server applies both.
An action: for an hour, a 60-foot flying speed; enemies within 30 feet save (WIS) or are frightened, and attacks against the frightened have advantage. The server rolls the saves.
An action: for a minute, resistance to all damage, one more attack with the Attack action, and melee weapon attacks that score a critical hit on a 19 or 20. The server applies all three.

A bonus action: for a minute, advantage on Charisma checks (the server applies it), once on each turn a missed weapon attack can hit instead, and a failed save can be rerolled with the reaction. A 5th-level spell slot buys another use.
A bonus action: truesight 120 feet and advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends for a minute. The server applies the advantage.
An action: for an hour, resistance to nonmagical weapon damage, and advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves for the paladin and allies within 30 feet. The server applies all of it.

An action: for a minute, a 30-foot aura of gloom; each enemy frightened of the oathbreaker that starts its turn in it takes 4d10 psychic, sight-reliant attackers have disadvantage against them, and a bonus action makes a melee spell attack with the shadows for 3d10 + Charisma necrotic (pc_attack weapon "Dread Lord's Shadows"). The server applies all of it.
An action: the sorcerer and up to 3 + CHA-modifier creatures within 30 feet gain a flying speed for an hour. The server marks them flying.

A bonus action: a 30-foot flying speed for 10 minutes (use_resource 'Elemental Flight'). The resistance is to the patron's damage type, chosen with Genie's Vessel (use_resource 'Genie's Vessel' with the patron's kind as the variant).
A bonus action in Guardian armor: temporary hit points equal to the artificer level (use_resource 'Defensive Field').

A reaction in Guardian armor when a Huge or smaller creature ends its turn within 30 feet: it saves on Strength or is pulled up to 25 feet toward the armorer, who may then attack it if it lands within 5 feet. The server rolls the save (use_reaction 'Perfected Armor').

The ward's hit points: twice the wizard level plus the Intelligence modifier. The first abjuration spell of 1st level or higher after a long rest raises it at full strength, damage to the wizard lands on it first, and each later abjuration spell restores twice its level. The server keeps it; nobody spends it by hand.
Whether the Arcane Ward has been raised since the last long rest (it is raised once a day, by the first abjuration spell of 1st level or higher). The server keeps it.

A reaction when the knight or a creature they can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack: the attack turns onto another creature within 30 feet of the knight, not the attacker, on the same roll. The server asks the knight's player at the hit, before its damage is rolled; a hit already dealt is not taken back.

A reaction when a creature the knight can see ends its turn within 30 feet: a Wisdom save (8 + proficiency + Constitution) or it is charmed for a minute, incapacitated with a speed of 0, saving again at the end of each of its turns. The server rolls the saves (use_reaction 'Stone Rune').

On a weapon hit: 2d6 extra fire damage, and a Strength save (8 + proficiency + Constitution) or the target is restrained by fiery shackles for a minute, taking 2d6 fire as each of its turns starts; it saves again at the end of each of its turns. use_resource "Fire Rune" with targetEnemyId; the server rolls the save, the damage and the burns.
A bonus action: +2 to every ability check and saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution for 10 minutes. The server adds it.
A bonus action: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage for 1 minute. The server applies it.

A bonus action: a minute of prophetic state, in which the knight's reaction turns an attack roll that hit them or a creature they can see within 60 feet to disadvantage (use_reaction "Prophetic State"), or gives advantage to an attack roll, save or check such a creature has just rolled, on its card.
